response.justification: Szabo brings strong technical fundamentals with 20+ years of software engineering experience and is currently contributing to AI-agent infrastructure work at re:cinq. However, his AI expertise is very recent (approximately 16 months) and lacks the depth, recognized standing, and demonstrated AI products/platforms that a principal-level AI strategy specialist role requires. He also lacks the advanced degree in an AI-related field preferred for this position.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience across multiple domains (web, mobile, desktop, embedded) significantly exceeds the 15-year minimum requirement
Currently contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks as Staff Engineer at re:cinq, demonstrating recent engagement with AI technologies
Proven ability to master diverse technology stacks and apply strong software craftsmanship principles (TDD, CI/CD, testing) across different roles and companies
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (approximately 16 months) with no prior demonstrated AI products, recognized expertise, or thought leadership in the field
Holds only Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and Photography/Video; lacks the Master's or PhD in AI-related field preferred for principal-level AI specialist roles
Career primarily focused on full-stack and systems development rather than AI strategy, technical innovation leadership, or advisory relationships with strategic customers
